source_facts.claim: Each stage/task/stream has a distinct output root, evaluator and optimizer invocation; only plan/source/config files are copied, never a candidate pool.

The exact reference cache is a local dict inside optimize; its key includes plan SHA and execution identity. A hit returns evidence alias semantics, never a final physics/controller object. Retained complete same-stream selections are verified and returned without evaluator work.

NominalCandidateEvaluator retains immutable identity/task references; a new noncached candidate gets new config/spec/scenario and a newly constructed TaskAnchoredResidualReferenceProvider. Existing unfinished candidate evidence blocks rerun.
run_synchronous_scenario constructs a new WholeBodyCollisionVerifier. Its constructor creates a new MjSpec and compiles a new model; the runner allocates a new live MjData.

Fresh live MjData uses the declared home/scenario initial state: planner home qpos, zero qvel except frozen scenario target twist, zero ctrl. Provider.prepare enforces exact Task qpos/qvel/time=0/home/dq and runner guards against provider mutation.

Each bounded-interval run creates new evaluator/QP/admission/next-start checker/private workspace; QP constructor initializes previous_velocity=0, duals={}, solve_count=0; optimized reaction cache begins empty.

Controller/reference history is initialized once per runner invocation. The same local QP/provider/model/data persist through the physics loop; no per-tick qp.reset is called. Runner passes current command_velocity as ramp start and keeps previous segment velocity.

Within-candidate QP warm start uses previous_velocity for acceleration bounds and primal initial vector, and persistent keyed constraint duals for ADMM initial_dual. Accepted commands update history; rejected commands clear duals according to original logic. Explicit reset clears the base QP history.

The provider retains a live feedback binding for one run and samples current state; it does not own a reference integral. The integral is runner-local reference_q_state, advanced and reassigned each servo step rather than rehomed each planning tick. Torque is computed from current feedback by original functions then consumed by mj_step.

Within-run optimized caches are instance-local: reaction key includes time/qpos/qvel/qM; preview workspace owns a separate MjData and reloads full integration state from live source each preview; copied reference_start prevents preview integration from advancing the live reference integral.

Formal VAL/TEST search requests use sequential blocking subprocess.run with a fresh _worker interpreter per stream request and one-thread env. Receipt is written after worker exit. Teacher streams and actual endpoints are not claimed to have their own subprocess; they rely on fresh per-run construction.

Each unique final actual enters the original execute_residual_attempt, constructs fresh provider/spec/scenario/config and calls the same runner; no private prediction state is passed. NO_PLAN consumes no actual, and exact aliases copy original evidence with zero new actual work.

Strict actual alias identity includes Task/model contract/plan/full declared cold-history policy plus four initial arrays/source identity/config/run-config hashes. Alias lookup is local to one task call; retained slots must match binding and original seals. The cold-history hash is a declared policy binding, not measured QP/controller telemetry.
